summary: Disaster Desk, Sunday teardown of World explained, Inside Decoded, Trace the Failure and Major Disasters. Added the channel's first 3 Shorts topics (the feed held only long ones), 2 challengers, and a high-priority fix proposal: the long-video feed is blocked.
why: Every 1M+ Short in the niche is a crash from the last 3-5 weeks (Learjet 2.56M at 669x subs, Spain trains 1.25M at 328x). Major Disasters' historic Shorts on our own feed's topics got 193-1,612 views. state offered the Shorts runs 0 topics, and generator/topics.py blocks every long topic since our first Short published.

findings.title: The breakouts are this month's crashes
findings.detail: Florida Learjet 2.56M / 1.91M, Spain trains 1.25M, New Orleans 70K on 3.8K-13K channels; older Fault Lines long videos 2-52K.

findings.title: Historic Shorts on our feed's stories did poorly elsewhere
findings.detail: Major Disasters: Hyatt, FIU, Oroville, Tacoma, Teton as 43-67 s 3D Shorts, 193-1,612 views. Exception: FedEx 80 at 7.6M (282x).

findings.title: Titles put a figure against a clock
findings.detail: 'Jet Fell 27,000 Feet in 60 Seconds' 2.56M; 'Two Minutes Later It Hit a Cruise Boat'. Queued as challenger dd-title-figure-clock.

findings.title: New Orleans: the rudder stuck, 2 minutes to impact, 22 to capsize
findings.detail: NTSB DCA27MM003 and its briefing via AP; preliminary report still to come.

findings.title: Long videos blocked by the Paisa from_short rule
findings.detail: winning_short() blocks every long topic once a channel has published a Short; this long-first channel can make none (0 of 4 this week).

changes.title: 3 Shorts topics
changes.detail: New Orleans stuck rudder (trending, 9.75, expires 25 Nov), FedEx 80 Narita (high, 10.18), Adamuz broken rail (8.75, waits on rail).

changes.title: 2 challengers
changes.detail: dd-title-figure-clock (first-second) and dd-short-75s (format, 60-90 s promo Shorts) in cycle/backlog.json.

changes.title: Proposal dd-long-feed-from-short-block
changes.detail: adopt, high: gate the from_short rule on the channel's cadence so long-first channels can plan long videos.
